tools_helpful.evidence: Copied source, rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml, preserved UWP .csproj at .uwp-source/; the dev-agent proceeded straight to file-by-file migration with no namespace churn.
Run after the build succeeded ('Now run the validator'); confirmed migration completeness before the agent declared done.

tool_limitations.limitation: Copies every legacy .cs including the VS-generated Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs, whose assembly-level attributes ([assembly: AssemblyTitle/Company/Configuration/Version/...]) collide with the SDK-style project's auto-generated attributes.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Exclude AssemblyInfo.cs from the copied build sources (same rationale as the existing ILC *.g.cs exclusion): SDK-style projects auto-generate these attributes.

special_apis.special_handling: Actions are hardware/event-gated; Authenticate/Skip/Abort stay disabled until a live hotspot auth event fires and Provision is a no-op without signed WLAN XML. Migrated as-is; no WinUI-specific API change required.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The UWP project's hand-authored Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs (standard VS boilerplate: AssemblyTitle/Description/Configuration/Company/Product/Copyright/Trademark/Culture/Version/FileVersion/ComVisible) was copied into the target and compiled by the SDK-style WinUI 3 csproj, which by default (GenerateAssemblyInfo=true) also emits the same assembly attributes into obj\...\<Project>.AssemblyInfo.cs.
errors_encountered.fix: Dev-agent added <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo> to the csproj so only the copied file supplies the attributes. Equivalent/cleaner fix: delete the superseded legacy AssemblyInfo.cs so the SDK generates them.

dev_agent_struggles.where: First build of the migrated project (build-events.jsonl, GenerateAssemblyInfo discussion ~L784-806)
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with 12x CS0579 duplicate assembly-attribute errors originating from obj\...\<Project>.AssemblyInfo.cs vs the copied Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Diagnosed and fixed in ~1-2 turns; not a long loop but the build was blocked until resolved.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Legacy UWP AssemblyInfo.cs copied verbatim clashes with SDK-style auto-generated assembly attributes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Bootstrap script excluding AssemblyInfo.cs from the copied build sources (Tier 1), and/or MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md documenting CS0579 root cause + fix (Tier 3).

env_issues.issue: Nullable warnings (CS8618/CS8600/CS8601/CS8602/CS8604/CS8625) from the scaffold's <Nullable>enable</Nullable> applied to legacy UWP code.
env_issues.workaround: Non-blocking; build succeeded. Inherent to enabling nullable on ported code; not a fidelity defect.
